rows.en: Touya: "...Honestly, it's a good thing you're safe,
but I told you to wait here, didn't I?"
Kasumi: "I'm sorry. But..."
Aurelie: "You did well."
Kasumi: "Huh?"
Aurelie: "I'm sorry I called you a burden earlier.
If your feelings let you move like that,
then that's the real thing."
Clovis: "Oh? What brought on this change of heart?"
Aurelie: "I mean I didn't need to worry
so much. I'm counting on you from now on... Kasumi."
Kasumi: "Y-Yes! I'm counting on you, too!"
Touya: "Good for you."
Kasumi: "Yeah... All I could think about was getting everyone
to accept me. But I didn't need to try so hard
to prove myself."
Touya: "Huh? You were thinking about something that stiff?"
Kasumi: "Yeah..."
Touya: "Why not just be yourself?
If you put on an act, it's just a fake, isn't it?
Then there's no point in doing it in the first place."
Kasumi: "You've changed, Touya-chan."
Touya: "Huh? Have I?"
Kasumi: "Yeah. You're kind of cool."
Touya: "What?! Ha, ha ha ha..."
Maki: "Reisuke, a little electromagnetic lock like this should be a cinch..."
Reisuke: "...Beep, beep, beep."
Maki: "...Of course it wouldn't be... What do I do...?
I can't believe I let myself get locked in..."
Maki: "I'm hungry..."
Murk: "...Well, what a splendid performance.
You defeated my Baluamy."
Touya: "How the hell did you make monsters like that?!"
Murk: "You're still green if you can't appreciate their beauty.
Well, never mind that. Thank you for your trouble.
Now I can return to the institute... I'll be going, then..."
Touya: "...Hold it!"
Murk: "What is it? If you want an autograph, can it wait?"
Touya: "I don't want one. What about that information?"
Murk: "Oh, that's right. Don't worry.
I remembered perfectly well."
Touya: (Liar...)
Murk: "Ahem! Now, about ≪Ze=Ode≫.
You know they've been supplying Zigrim with technology,
don't you? Well, the one providing it
is a man named Lyle Enroad."
Ymir: "Lyle Enroad...?"
Murk: "Would it help if I said he's the man you fought?"
Ai: "Oh!"
Murk: "He's cooperating with Zigrim's General Growster.
But Growster himself doesn't seem to know
that the man is with ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Ymir: "Is this Lyle still in Zigrim?"
Murk: "Yes. Near the border with York,
he's at an abandoned facility."
Touya: "What?! That had better be true!"
Murk: "How rude! My information network is...
a little unreliable, but it's probably fine!"
Celica: "Probably...?"
Murk: "Now, then. I'll be going."
Ymir: "Oh, wait... Professor!"
Murk: "Yes, no need to thank me.
I'll count this as a favor you owe me."
Touya: "Hey! You can't just..."
Murk: "We'll meet again somewhere! Farewell!"
Touya: "Oh, he cut us off..."
Captain Roa: "Hmm..."
Ymir: "Yes. It's certainly not very credible,
but it doesn't seem to be complete nonsense, either..."
Arthur: "Why don't we contact the Holy Land
and ask them to check?
There's also the matter of Lady Celica."
Celica: "Well, I think it's about time I..."
Ai: "Derock!"
Derock: "Please forgive me, Princess..."
Celica: "Huh? What? When did you...?!"
Clovis: "Wh-What was that speed?!
Can a human even move like that?!"
Derock: "Tsk, tsk, tsk. Don't underestimate me."
Celica: "Hey, let me go! Derock!"
Derock: "If you're going to hold a grudge, blame this life
aboard the Liebhofen with no snacks."
Celica: "Y-You were bribed with food?!"
Derock: "Sugar is the energy for tomorrow."
Ai: "Hmm, I never thought a chocolate bar would come in handy like this.
Thanks, Bart."
Bart: "...Heh."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "Anyway, let's contact the Holy Land."
Ymir: "R-Right..."
Lodis: "...I see. Then it's certain Zigrim has been receiving
technology from them.
If Dr. Berol had acted sooner,
it would've been better..."
Ymir: "Is something wrong?"
Lodis: "Negotiations between Agarthia and Zigrim have broken down.
The experimental organisms that appeared in York
were cited as one reason.
At this rate, war looks very likely."
Ymir: "That's... just a pretext...!!"
Lodis: "Yes. They intended to start a war from the beginning.
They were only looking for a pretext.
But thanks to that, the hostility aimed at us
has been redirected toward Zigrim."
Clovis: "War..."
Lodis: "Lady Ivel is working to prevent war
from breaking out, but...
I intend to head to the capital and attend the meeting myself.
...By the way, is Celica there?"
Celica: "...Yes."
Lodis: "...Celica.
Would you care to explain?"
Celica: "Um... W-Well, I designed the Spirit Mechs,
and without their designer, things would be
inconvenient. Besides, I have nothing to do back in the capital,
and it's boring..."
Lodis: "...*sigh*
You're Agarthia's First Princess, you know?
You should remember..."
Celica: "That's not right. Being royalty doesn't mean
I can run away somewhere safe on my own.
Besides, everyone gathered here
has put status aside, haven't they?
We're people who want to fight for Agarthia's peace,
who share the same goal.
I want to do what I can for that."
Lodis: "Celica..."
Celica: "Besides, I have a dependable bodyguard."
Fain: "Huh? Y-You mean me...?"
Celica: "Of course. Am I wrong?"
Fain: "O-Of course not! I'll risk my life
to protect you, Princess!"
Ymir: "Your Highness, Lady Celica is indispensable to us,
too. I'd like to ask you to let her stay as well."
Lodis: "...All right. But don't do anything reckless.
That's a request from your brother, not the Crown Prince."
Celica: "Lodis..."
Lodis: "..."
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Lodis: "...Is that true?
...Understood."
Celica: "Lodis? Is something wrong?"
Lodis: "Oh, sorry. I've just received a report.
Apparently, in the forest east of Shangria, a reaction extremely close to ≪Ze=Ode≫
was picked up.
But it seems slightly different from Rayode last time."
Touya: "Then it's someone else this time?"
Lodis: "We don't know. Apparently the reaction lasted only an instant.
There's also reported activity at the facility in Zigrim.
I'll leave the decision about what to do next to you."
Ymir: "...There are two options.
Head to Agarthia's capital, or to the facility in Zigrim..."
Xiujian: "If the reaction near the capital is ≪Ze=Ode≫,
and its Pilot is there, too,
they may have infiltrated the capital.
We don't know why they aren't attacking with a ≪Ze=Ode≫ machine,
but if destruction isn't their goal,
perhaps they have business inside the capital."
Arthur: "But finding one particular person in that enormous capital
would be like finding a single grain of sand in a desert.
I think we should investigate the facility in Zigrim."
Fain: "But if ≪Ze=Ode≫ starts destroying things,
it'll be a disaster. We should return to the capital!"
Captain Roa: "...Hmm."
Ymir: "Huh? M-Me?
...Understood..."
Touya: "What did he say?"
Ymir: "He said to leave it to my judgment...
But what should we do...? Touya, what do you think?"
We should go to the capital.
Encourage Ymir
The facility in Zigrim.
Ymir: "You're right. Let's investigate there first.
Baren, please."
Baren: "...Understood."
Lodis: "Then, for now, I'll
look into things at the capital.
I'm counting on you to take care of Celica. Goodbye."
Assistant: "Professor, that facility isn't actually a ≪Ze=Ode≫
base, you know."
Murk: "It just slipped out."
Assistant: "Oh, but come to think of it, isn't that
the former 'Code 3' site...?"
Murk: "What are you muttering about? Come on, let's go."
Assistant: "Oh, Professor, that's the wrong way.
Weren't you going back to the institute?"
Murk: "Who said that, and when?"
Assistant: "You did, Professor. Just now, with your own mouth."
Murk: "Hmm. I've forgotten such ancient history.
The situation is always changing.
If you don't adapt, the times will leave you behind!"
Assistant: "Th-Then where are we going?"
Murk: "..."
Assistant: "Professor?"
Murk: "...That way!"
Ymir: "We do have to consider what might happen, after all.
Your Highness, we'll head to the capital."
Lodis: "I see. Understood.
Then, the palace... No, that wouldn't do...
Ymir, do you remember Rosalie's shop?"
Ymir: "Yes. The one on Crusiel Street, right?"
Lodis: "Yes. Let's meet there.
See you later."
Baren: "...I'm setting course for Agarthia's capital,
Shangria."
Assistant: "Professor, that facility isn't actually a ≪Ze=Ode≫
base, you know."
Murk: "It just slipped out."
Assistant: "O-Oh..."
Murk: "Why are you dawdling? Come on, let's go."
Assistant: "Oh, Professor, that's the wrong way.
Weren't you going back to the institute?"
Murk: "Who said that, and when?"
Assistant: "You did, Professor. Just now, with your own mouth."
Murk: "Hmm. I've forgotten such ancient history.
The situation is always changing.
If you don't adapt, the times will leave you behind!"
Assistant: "Th-Then where are we going?"
Murk: "..."
Assistant: "Professor?"
Murk: "...That way!"
Touya: "You're taking this too seriously.
Are you worrying about what might happen
if you make the wrong decision?"
Ymir: "Huh? Y-Yes..."
Touya: "There's no point worrying about that
before you've even decided.
If you're wrong, we can think about it then.
That's why we're all here. Right?"
Ymir: "You're right... I'm sorry.
Perhaps I was running away.
Thank you, Touya."
Touya: "Don't mention it."
Ymir: "...Let's go to the capital.
We do have to consider what might happen, after all.
Your Highness, we'll be heading there, too."
Lodis: "I see. Understood.
Then, the palace... No, that wouldn't do...
Ymir, do you remember Rosalie's shop?"
Ymir: "Yes. The one on Crusiel Street, right?"
